items.source: Base class for RepositoryEvents that deal with saving/updating or deleting a linked object.
items.translation: 处理保存/更新或删除关联对象的RepositoryEvent的基类。

items.source: Abstract class that listens for generic RepositoryEvents and dispatches them to a specific method based on the event type.
items.translation: 抽象类，用于监听通用的RepositoryEvent，并根据事件类型将它们分发到特定方法。

items.source: Component to discover annotated repository event handlers and trigger them on ApplicationEvents.
items.translation: 用于发现已注解的仓库事件处理器，并在 ApplicationEvent 上触发它们的组件。

items.source: Event that is emitted after a new entity is saved.
items.translation: 在新实体保存后触发的已发射事件。

items.source: Emitted after the entity is deleted from the repository.
items.translation: 实体从存储库删除后发出。

items.source: Emitted after a link to a related object is deleted from the parent.
items.translation: 在从父对象中删除对相关对象的链接后发出。

items.source: Emitted after saving a linked object to its parent in the repository.
items.translation: 在将链接对象保存到其父对象的存储库后发出。

items.source: Emitted after a save to the repository.
Event emitted before an entity is saved for the first time.
items.translation: 在实体首次保存之前触发的已发出事件。

items.source: Emitted before an entity is deleted from the repository.
items.translation: 在实体从存储库删除之前发出。

items.source: Emitted before a link to a related object is deleted from the parent.
items.translation: 在从父对象中删除对相关对象的链接之前发出。

items.source: Emitted before a linked object is saved to the repository.
items.translation: 在将链接对象保存到存储库之前发出。

items.source: Emitted before an entity is saved into the repository.
items.translation: 在将实体保存到仓库之前发出。

items.source: An event to encapsulate an exception occurring anywhere within the REST exporter.
items.translation: 用于封装在 REST 导出器中任何位置发生的异常的事件。

items.source: Uses of RepositoryEvent in org.springframework.data.rest.core.event
items.translation: RepositoryEvent 在 org.springframework.data.rest.core.event 中的用途
